div.h2:
Good to know
before you go.
div.p: Find quick answers about membership, shifts, volunteer hours and your participation certificate.

details.summary: How do I add a family volunteer?
details.p: Sign in with the primary membership, select “Add New Volunteer,” enter the volunteer’s name and complete registration.

details.summary: How do I book a volunteering shift?
details.p: Use the primary membership to view available days, book a schedule and choose a meal distribution location.
Volunteer hours are recorded individually for each person under the primary membership. Check that the entries are accurate.

details.summary: Can I receive a volunteer certificate?
details.p: At the end of the campaign, a certificate can be printed in each volunteer’s name based on the recorded hours.
